reasoning: Jerome's Epistolae have a substantial prior English translation in NPNF Series II Vol. 6 (Fremantle, Lewis, Martley, 1893), covering ~120+ letters (I–CL). Volume 1 of the Manuzio edition contains a subset of these same letters; all fall within the NPNF coverage. The Manuzio Latin edition is the work, not a distinct intermediary. Not the first English.
